prompt:
This is a native tool-output compatibility test. Do not inspect files, use subagents, or perform any project work. Execute exactly these four harmless commands sequentially using exec_command, one tool call each. Use the indicated max_output_tokens. Record only whether the requested command ran, then say CAPTURE DONE.
1. printf 'BARBARO-CODEX-SMALL\n' with max_output_tokens 10000.
2. /opt/homebrew/bin/node -e "process.stdout.write('Q'.repeat(9000))" with max_output_tokens 10000.
3. /opt/homebrew/bin/node -e "process.stdout.write('LIMIT'.repeat(1000))" with max_output_tokens 64.
4. sh -c 'echo BARBARO-FAIL-STDERR >&2; exit 3' with max_output_tokens 10000.
The nonzero exit is intentional; do not repair or retry it. Do not call any other tool.
